taxonomy-panel.name: Taxonomy Panel
taxonomy-panel.description: When a search query matches a taxon in the GBIF backbone, shows a card above results with the full classification tree, IUCN status, occurrence stats and a range map.

minConfidence.label: Match confidence
minConfidence.description: 0–100. Only queries the GBIF backbone matches with at least this confidence show a card.

skipTerms.label: Never show for
skipTerms.description: Comma-separated words that get no card even when GBIF matches them — for names that are also common non-biology search terms, like the Python programming language.

showMap.label: Show range map
showMap.description: Include GBIF's occurrence density map in the card.

showStats.label: Show occurrence stats
showStats.description: Occurrence count, top countries and last recorded date.

showPhoto.label: Show representative photo
showPhoto.description: One occurrence photo of the taxon in the card header.
